dashboard.label: Darkmoon — Set up
dashboard.description: Configure the Darkmoon Pro connection. The API token is stored encrypted in Splunk (storage/passwords) — never in a .conf file.

div.p: The alert action and this setup call the Darkmoon Pro REST API (Pro feature). The open-source Darkmoon CLI does not expose this API. Ingestion and dashboards work without this configuration.

div.label: Base URL
div.span: Verified HTTPS is required by default. HTTP or unverified TLS requires explicit trusted-lab mode.

div.label: API token
div.span: Stored encrypted under username "darkmoon" with a new credential reference on rotation. Leave blank only to retain the token for the same base URL.
